hooks.title: Wagons Turned Back
hooks.text: Grand Syndic Sonan has closed the border to carts from Vilmon, and the carters' guild is threatening to march on Viflol. Hierarch Taerun needs proof the blockade breaks an old treaty.

hooks.title: A Lord in Revolt
hooks.text: Castellan Lainar of Nere has closed the gates to the crown's tax-gatherers. Old slights Hierarch Taerun needs a go-between before blood is spilt.

hooks.title: The Tax Strike
hooks.text: Hierarch Taerun takes 14 in every hundred on trade, about 31250 sp a year, and the towns grumble. A pamphleteer calling for a tax strike must be found, or protected, depending on who pays.

hooks.title: Opened Graves
hooks.text: Old graves from the Mire Ague have been opened in the night. The folk of Vilmon whisper that someone wants the sickness back.

hooks.title: Treasure-Hunters
hooks.text: Treasure-hunters are digging at Haholm, near Viflol. Hierarch Taerun wants them stopped, or wants a share.

reasons: About 43,676 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought four wars in recorded memory.
Five settlements changed hands between them by the sword.
The last war between them ended only 29 years ago.

events.title: The founding of Vilmon
events.text: Wearied of paying tribute to everyone, 0 settlements around Viflol agree to answer to one table, and call it Vilmon.

events.title: House Stavik founds Vilmon
events.text: House Stavik takes the lordship of Vilmon at its founding.

events.title: Hierarch Hanen of Vilmon
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Hanen of House Stavik becomes Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: A vote at Viflol
events.text: The ring of the elders is passed to House Seisen, and Vilmon has a new ruling family.
events.name: The Choosing of 47
events.backstory: The custom of Vilmon is to choose its rulers, and in 47 the electors passed over Stavik for House Seisen.

events.title: Hierarch Hirik the Generous of Vilmon
events.text: Hirik the Generous of House Seisen is raised as Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: Viflol in flames
events.text: A fire in the lower lanes burns a third of Viflol.
events.name: The Burning Night of Viflol
events.backstory: The blaze began with a forgotten lamp in a chandler's loft; by morning Viflol was ash.

events.title: House Saenavik elected in Vilmon
events.text: Delegates gather at Viflol and, after three days of argument, choose House Saenavik to rule Vilmon.
events.name: The Moot of Saenavik
events.backstory: The custom of Vilmon is to choose its rulers, and in 74 the electors passed over Seisen for House Saenavik.

events.title: Hierarch Leikulf of Vilmon
events.text: Leikulf takes the seat of Vilmon.

events.title: High water at Edede
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Edede stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A bank of the Fefindelv gave way in 87 above Edede, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: Hierarch Saedis of Vilmon
events.text: Saedis takes the seat of Vilmon.

events.title: High water at Nere
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Nere stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A bank of the Fefindelv gave way in 119 above Nere, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The great flood at Ucheshch
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Ucheshch.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 123, and Ucheshch had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Hierarch Neivar the Patient of Vilmon
events.text: Vilmon bows to Neivar the Patient, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Saenavik.

events.title: The Marrow Chill at Ykroy
events.text: First seen at Ykroy, the sickness follows carters and pilgrims to Liginik, Dindokrym, Noflel and 68 other places.
events.name: The Marrow Chill
events.backstory: Traders brought the Marrow Chill to Ykroy, and it rode their carts as far as Liginik, Dindokrym, Noflel and 68 other places.

events.title: High water at Uklu
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Uklu stand in brown water.
events.name: The Great Fefindelv Spate of 130
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Fefindelv through Uklu in 130.

events.title: The sickness empties Gleglade
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Gleglade after the fever, and the cottar row slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Marrow Chill refused to remain at Gleglade, and the cottar row was left to the weeds in 130.

events.title: The usurper of Vilmon
events.text: Blades are drawn in the hall at Viflol; by morning House Braestrand holds Vilmon.
events.name: The Oathbreaking of 133
events.backstory: Those who served Saenavik were given a choice that night in 133, and most chose to live.

events.title: Hierarch Brydis the Patient of Vilmon
events.text: Brydis the Patient takes the seat of Vilmon.

events.title: The Long Raid on Keveth
events.text: Raiding and reprisals around Keveth turn into open war between Ykar and Vilmon.
events.name: The Long Raid on Keveth
events.backstory: Ykar raised the toll on Keveth bridge, Vilmon refused to pay, and the Long Raid on Keveth was the result.

events.title: The Truce at Keveth
events.text: The war ends with Ykar's banners over Keveth and Lethyokolf; Vilmon signs to keep the rest.

events.title: Ykar takes Keveth
events.text: Keveth is handed from Vilmon to Ykar.
events.backstory: Keveth was one of the spoils of the Long Raid on Keveth, and changed hands in 147 without a single arrow.

events.title: Lethyokolf passes to Ykar
events.text: Lethyokolf is handed from Vilmon to Ykar.
events.backstory: Ykar claimed Lethyokolf as the price of the Long Raid on Keveth, and Vilmon was in no position to refuse.

events.title: Hierarch Haela of Vilmon
events.text: Vilmon bows to Haela, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Braestrand.

events.title: Hierarch Vamund of Vilmon
events.text: Vilmon bows to Vamund, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Braestrand.

events.title: Droholt is abandoned
events.text: Raiders return to Droholt each autumn until the ferry village has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: The Rochynch flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rochynch.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Rochynch.

events.title: Veiwick is abandoned
events.text: Raiders strike Veiwick twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Hlergeflel.

events.title: High water at Chagsich
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Schilonich and Chagsich.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Chagsich.

events.title: The Border War of 180
events.text: Ykar marches on Slelfe, and Vilmon answers in kind; neither will name the first blow.
events.name: The Border War of 180
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Slelfe until Ykar and Vilmon chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Peace of Slelfe
events.text: The war ends with Ykar's banners over Slelfe; Vilmon signs to keep the rest.

events.title: Slelfe passes to Ykar
events.text: Surveyors from Ykar drive new stakes at Slelfe, and Vilmon does not send anyone to pull them up.
events.backstory: After the Border War of 180, the people of Slelfe found their new lords had little interest in their old customs.

events.title: The great flood at Vedtelmekrym
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Vedtelmekrym and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A bank of the Fefindelv gave way in 186 above Vedtelmekrym, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The electors of Vilmon choose
events.text: Delegates gather at Viflol and, after three days of argument, choose House Sasen to rule Vilmon.
events.name: The Raising of House Sasen
events.backstory: The custom of Vilmon is to choose its rulers, and in 188 the electors passed over Braestrand for House Sasen.

events.title: Hierarch Sekydis of Vilmon
events.text: Vilmon bows to Sekydis, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Sasen.

events.title: The Tallow Cough at Ekysoth
events.text: First seen at Ekysoth, the sickness follows carters and pilgrims to Tweehol, Ethefoth, Thwyldehol and 151 other places.
events.name: The Tallow Cough
events.backstory: The Tallow Cough spread fastest among the starved: the Geaflow Hunger had stripped Ykar of its strength just before.

events.title: Gugraifell is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Gugraifell after the sickness, and the hunters' lodge falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Tallow Cough emptied Gugraifell, and the hunters' lodge was abandoned in 189.

events.title: The sickness empties Haholm
events.text: Whole families die at Haholm, and the few who live join kin at Viflol.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Tallow Cough refused to remain at Haholm, and the charcoal-burners' camp was left to the weeds in 191.

events.title: Dredun is abandoned
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Dredun after the fever, and the market village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Tallow Cough refused to remain at Dredun, and the market village was left to the weeds in 192.

events.title: Silence at Brorach
events.text: The last families leave Brorach after the sickness, and the ferry village falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Tallow Cough emptied Brorach, and the ferry village was abandoned in 192.

events.title: The great flood at Choglosryl
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rogalat and Choglosryl.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 193, and Choglosryl had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Laedell is abandoned
events.text: Raiders strike Laedell twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Slelyeld.

events.title: Becrag cleared by its lord
events.text: The lord clears Becrag for sheep, and its tenants are turned out onto the road.

events.title: The great flood at Rochralad
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rochralad and Wichsil.
events.name: The Great Fefindelv Spate of 201
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 201, and Rochralad had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The electors of Vilmon choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Vilmon vote, and House Myvik wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Choosing of 203
events.backstory: Sasen ruled until 203, when the assembly of Vilmon gave the office to House Myvik.

events.title: Hierarch Vanoken the Patient of Vilmon
events.text: Vanoken the Patient of House Myvik is raised as Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: High water at Schilonich
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Schilonich, Chargadrych and Rolosryl.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Schilonich.

events.title: High water at Lesveemse
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Lesveemse.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Lesveemse.

events.title: The Chagshot flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Chagshot.
events.name: The Great Fefindelv Spate of 208
events.backstory: A warm wind in 208 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The Ykar Reckoning at Chraagegeut
events.text: Envoys from Ykar and Vilmon part in anger at Chraagegeut, and within the season both are mustering.
events.name: The Ykar Reckoning at Chraagegeut
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Chraagegeut until Ykar and Vilmon chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Treaty of Chraagegeut
events.text: Terms are read out at Chraagegeut: Chraagegeut to Ykar, and a promise of quiet from Vilmon.

events.title: Chraagegeut passes to Ykar
events.text: The folk of Chraagegeut wake to find themselves subjects of Ykar.
events.backstory: After the Ykar Reckoning at Chraagegeut, the people of Chraagegeut found their new lords had little interest in their old customs.

events.title: The great flood at Eeyede
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Eeyede.
events.name: The Drowning of Eeyede
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 225, and Eeyede was caught asleep.

events.title: A vote at Viflol
events.text: The ring of the elders is passed to House Naeling, and Vilmon has a new ruling family.
events.name: The Electors' Oath at Viflol
events.backstory: The custom of Vilmon is to choose its rulers, and in 226 the electors passed over Myvik for House Naeling.

events.title: Hierarch Heiveig of Vilmon
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Heiveig of House Naeling becomes Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: High water at Schilcha
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Schilcha and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 227, and Schilcha was caught asleep.

events.title: The fall of the Teleelefeth galleries
events.text: The roof comes down in the Teleelefeth workings, and the shift below is lost.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Teleelefeth for a season, and in 229 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: High water at Schilwonch
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Schilwonch stand in brown water.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 231, and Schilwonch was caught asleep.

events.title: Miners lost at Slelyeld
events.text: The roof comes down in the Slelyeld workings, and the shift below is lost.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Slelyeld for a season, and in 231 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: The Cherchygchol flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Cherchygchol stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 233 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Schilonich
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Schilonich and Chagsich.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 234, and Schilonich had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The fall of the Schilonich galleries
events.text: The deep workings at Schilonich come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Schilonich for a season, and in 234 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: The Deme flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Deme stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 236 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Gralgachryrad
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Gralgachryrad stand in brown water.
events.name: The Drowning of Gralgachryrad
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 237, and Gralgachryrad had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: House Kystrand elected in Vilmon
events.text: The electors of Vilmon raise House Kystrand to rule.
events.name: The Raising of House Kystrand
events.backstory: Naeling ruled until 238, when the assembly of Vilmon gave the office to House Kystrand.

events.title: Hierarch Tony the Tall of Vilmon
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Tony the Tall of House Kystrand becomes Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: The great flood at Chargyl
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Chargyl stand in brown water.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 238
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 238, and Chargyl had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Raiders at Lesund
events.text: Lesund is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the market village is then left to the owls.

events.title: The great flood at Jaalnyneut
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Ucheshch and Jaalnyneut and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 247, and Jaalnyneut was caught asleep.

events.title: The Mire Ague at Viflol
events.text: Carried along the roads from Viflol, it empties houses in Fromogsi, Sidgorn, Vilypor and 91 other places.
events.name: The Mire Ague
events.backstory: The Mire Ague began in Viflol in 248, where drinking water had been tainted ever since the flood of 247.

events.title: The fall of the Schildinchanch galleries
events.text: The deep workings at Schildinchanch come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: The pit props at Schildinchanch had not been replaced in years, and in 248 the roof gave way without warning.

events.title: Thofell is abandoned
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Thofell after the fever, and the mill hamlet slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The Mire Ague emptied Thofell, and the mill hamlet was abandoned in 248.

events.title: The sickness empties Fyskistrand
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Fyskistrand after the fever, and the hamlet slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The Mire Ague emptied Fyskistrand, and the hamlet was abandoned in 248.

events.title: Silt over Skevestrand
events.text: The river takes the well, the fields and the footbridge of Skevestrand, and the salt-works village is let go.
events.backstory: Skevestrand lay in the path of the flood of 247, and the salt-works village was given up in 248.

events.title: High water at Schilichlylot
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Schilonich and Schilichlylot stand in brown water.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 249, and Schilichlylot had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Silence at Grateholt
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Grateholt after the fever, and the walled village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Mire Ague reached Grateholt; by 249 the walled village was empty.

events.title: Silence at Baicrag
events.text: The last families leave Baicrag after the sickness, and the farmstead falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Mire Ague reached Baicrag; by 249 the farmstead was empty.

events.title: Hebrothorpe is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Hebrothorpe after the sickness, and the village falls to nettles.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Mire Ague refused to remain at Hebrothorpe, and the village was left to the weeds in 250.

events.title: Gurthuholt is abandoned
events.text: Whole families die at Gurthuholt, and the few who live join kin at Chagwochchar.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Mire Ague reached Gurthuholt; by 250 the farmstead was empty.

events.title: Kaidun is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Kaidun after the sickness, and the village falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Mire Ague emptied Kaidun, and the village was abandoned in 250.

events.title: The sickness empties Keholm
events.text: The sickness has emptied Keholm; the survivors burn their belongings and walk away from the village.
events.backstory: The Mire Ague emptied Keholm, and the village was abandoned in 251.

events.title: The Nere flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Nere and Chagse.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 252 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Tychlosryl
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rochryrat and Tychlosryl.
events.name: The Fefindelv Rising of 252
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 252, and Tychlosryl had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Rorernat
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Rorernat and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Rorernat.

events.title: The fall of the Stechchynch galleries
events.text: A seam gives way at Stechchynch, and the rescue crews dig until the lamps run dry.
events.backstory: A spring broke into the deep gallery at Stechchynch in 252, and the pumps could not keep pace.

events.title: The Vichgyrgich flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Vichgyrgich stand in brown water.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Vichgyrgich.

events.title: Silt over Biwell
events.text: The river takes the well, the fields and the footbridge of Biwell, and the market village is let go.
events.backstory: The flood of 252 left Biwell a swamp, and the market village was abandoned in 253.

events.title: The fall of the Uklu galleries
events.text: Old galleries give way beneath Uklu, burying a shift of miners.
events.backstory: The mine owners at Uklu skimped on props, and the miners paid for it in 255.

events.title: The Cherchynch flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Cherchynch.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 256, and Cherchynch was caught asleep.

events.title: A new house at Viflol
events.text: The old line fails, and the lords of Vilmon give the crown to House Stymodahl.
events.name: The Crown Without Heir of 257
events.backstory: Kystrand left no children, and the councillors of Vilmon gave the crown to House Stymodahl to avoid a war.

events.title: Hierarch Skimund of Vilmon
events.text: Skimund of House Stymodahl is raised as Hierarch of Vilmon.

events.title: The great flood at Rochynch
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rolech, Rochynch, Rogirnach and 3 other places.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Fefindelv through Rochynch in 257.

events.title: The great flood at Edeveth
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Edeveth and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Fefindelv through Edeveth in 257.

events.title: Mainaibury is abandoned
events.text: Sheep are worth more to the lord than tenants, and the hamlet at Mainaibury is cleared.

events.title: High water at Rogirnach
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Rogirnach and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Fefindelv Rising of 260
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 260, and Rogirnach was caught asleep.

events.title: The Long Raid on Lethfe
events.text: Old grievances at Lethfe set Ykar and Vilmon at each other's throats.
events.name: The Long Raid on Lethfe
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Lethfe until Ykar and Vilmon chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Tychlosryl flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Tychlosryl.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 263 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The Treaty of Lethfe
events.text: Vilmon kneels, in the way such things are done, and Ykar rides home with Lethfe.

events.title: The new border at Lethfe
events.text: Surveyors from Ykar drive new stakes at Lethfe, and Vilmon does not send anyone to pull them up.
events.backstory: Ykar claimed Lethfe as the price of the Long Raid on Lethfe, and Vilmon was in no position to refuse.

events.title: The great flood at Uklu
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Uklu.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 265, and Uklu had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Chaglech
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Chaglech.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Fefindelv carried the whole winter down on Chaglech.

events.title: The Rolech flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rolech, Rochynch and Cherchagrachad.
events.name: The Great Fefindelv Spate
events.backstory: A warm wind in 269 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: Collapse at the Lichralnech mines
events.text: Old galleries give way beneath Lichralnech, burying a shift of miners.
events.backstory: Cheap, rotting timber held up the galleries of Lichralnech until it did not, in 269.

events.title: The great flood at Schilosha
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Schilosha.
events.backstory: The Fefindelv rose a fathom in a night in 272, and Schilosha had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The great flood at Roler
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Rochynch and Roler stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 275 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Fefindelv filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The fall of the Natfekrym galleries
events.text: The deep workings at Natfekrym come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Natfekrym for a season, and in 276 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: Raiders at Haiwick
events.text: Raiders return to Haiwick each autumn until the farmstead has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: Hierarch Taerun of Vilmon
events.text: Vilmon bows to Taerun, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Stymodahl.

events.title: The Nireebur flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Nireebur.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Fefindelv over its banks in 283, and Nireebur was caught asleep.

events.title: Veihavn is abandoned
events.text: Raiders strike Veihavn twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Frore.

events.title: Lyglade dies of thirst
events.text: Two dry summers dry the well of Lyglade, and the hamlet sets out for water.

events.title: Grocraig dies of thirst
events.text: No one at Grocraig can dig deeper, so the mill hamlet is left to the crows.

events.title: Stosund is abandoned
events.text: Stosund is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the shepherds' steading is then left to the owls.

events.title: Sheep replace the folk of Daidaidun
events.text: Sheep are worth more to the lord than tenants, and the walled village at Daidaidun is cleared.

events.title: Thoaham dies of thirst
events.text: The well at Thoaham fails in a dry summer, and the hunters' lodge is left to the crows.

events.title: Vurcraig given up to the raiders
events.text: Tired of being robbed, the folk of the mill hamlet at Vurcraig walk the road to Rochtal and take what they can carry.

events.title: Draternach is abandoned
events.text: The tenants of Draternach are paid to leave, and the walls of the hamlet are used for the sheepfold.

events.title: Collapse at the Gragcha mines
events.text: The roof comes down in the Gragcha workings, and the shift below is lost.
events.backstory: The pit props at Gragcha had not been replaced in years, and in 288 the roof gave way without warning.

events.title: The fall of the Amto galleries
events.text: Old galleries give way beneath Amto, burying a shift of miners.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Amto for a season, and in 290 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: The Chagshot flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Chagshot and Rocharch.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Fefindelv through Chagshot in 292.
